copy.step0_intro_1: When we water-talents go to the mainland, we always make sure the water drops in the morning mist are just the right size.
copy.step0_intro_2: It used to be hard to measure them all, but not anymore -- Tink invented a Mist Meter! She's going to make enough of them for all of us to use!
copy.step0_intro_3: That means she needs lots of Bits of Metal. Can you help find some? Finding them will help you practice your Talent Skills!
copy.step0_summary: Tink invented a Mist Meter, and she needs Bits of Metal to make more for the water-talents. Find Bits of Metal in The Never Mine Wilderness!
